question: Amy has _____ friends in her new school.
explanation: friends 是可數名詞，用 many

question: There isn't _____ milk in the fridge.
explanation: milk 是不可數名詞，否定句用 much

question: We have _____ time before the movie. Don't worry!
explanation: time 不可數，「有一點，夠用」用 a little（正面語氣）

question: _____ students passed the test. It was too hard.
explanation: students 可數，「幾乎沒有」用 Few（負面語氣）

question: Can I have _____ water, please?
explanation: 請求/邀請的問句可以用 some（water 不可數）

question: I don't have _____ homework today.
explanation: homework 不可數，否定句用 much

question: There are _____ chairs in the room. We need more.
explanation: chairs 可數，「很少、不夠」用 few（負面語氣）

question: She has _____ money. She can buy that toy.
explanation: money 不可數，「有一點，夠買」用 a little（正面語氣）

question: Are there _____ books on the shelf?
explanation: books 可數，疑問句用 any

question: He eats _____ food every day. He's always hungry!
explanation: food 不可數，肯定句中「很多」用 a lot of 比 much 更自然

question: We don't have _____ water left. Please buy some.
explanation: water 不可數，否定句用 much

question: There are _____ students in the classroom today. Almost everyone is here!
explanation: students 可數，「很多」用 many

question: I have only _____ money. I can't buy that shirt.
explanation: money 不可數，「幾乎沒有」用 little（負面語氣）

question: Do you have _____ friends in this city?
explanation: friends 可數，疑問句用 any

question: There is _____ milk in the glass. That's enough for me.
explanation: milk 不可數，「有一點，夠用」用 a little（正面語氣）

question: _____ of the food on the table is delicious.
explanation: food 不可數，「大多數」用 Most

question: She has _____ books. She loves reading!
explanation: books 可數，「很多」用 many

question: I have _____ time to finish this. I need help!
explanation: time 不可數，「幾乎沒有」用 little（負面語氣）

question: There are _____ chairs for everyone. We have just enough.
explanation: chairs 可數，「有幾個，夠用」用 a few（正面語氣）

question: He doesn't drink _____ milk every day.
explanation: milk 不可數，否定句用 much

explanation: milk 是不可數名詞，不能用 many，應改用 much

question: "a few books" 的用法正確嗎？
explanation: books 是可數名詞，a few 用法正確

question: "much students" 的用法正確嗎？
explanation: students 是可數名詞，不能用 much，應改用 many

question: "a little time" 的用法正確嗎？
explanation: time 是不可數名詞，a little 用法正確

question: "few water" 的用法正確嗎？
explanation: water 是不可數名詞，不能用 few，應改用 little

explanation: sugar 不可數，肯定句用 some

explanation: eggs 可數，「很少、不夠」用 few（負面語氣）

explanation: people 可數，「來了幾個人，很好玩」用 A few（正面語氣）

explanation: information 不可數，請求句用 some

question: He has _____ money. He can't even buy a bus ticket.
explanation: money 不可數，「幾乎沒有」用 little（負面語氣，買不起票）

question: We have _____ options. Let's choose the best one!
explanation: options 可數，「有幾個選擇」用 a few（正面語氣）
